name: Richard Liu
source:
Dick is the 12th grader presiding over Happy Valley High's art club.

Mature and handsome, he immediately strikes Mimi as the perfect leading man, but the leading man for whom...?

[From [url=http://www.stardust-soda.com/through-the-panels/]official website[/url]]

Born in 1994.
Hometown: Kent, UK.
